title: Korean Pear Tarts
description: A sweet and crunchy dessert using pear and a flaky pastry crust. Perfect for a vegan dinner party.

ingredients.name: Nourishing Pastry Dough
ingredients.notes: made with vegan butter and plant-based milk

instructions: Roll out the pastry dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass
Place a spoonful of pear slices in the center of each dough circle
Fold the dough over the pears to form a triangle and press the edges to seal
Brush the tops of the tarts with a little water and sprinkle with Korean chili flakes
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown
Drizzle with maple syrup and serve warm
